headlines.text: Turning the clock back to 2026: Jack Perry reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Young Bucks & Perry vs. The Demand on Dynamite, rated 7.78 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle in a wild trios sprint.
Rewind to 2022, when Jake Atlas laced up for their first AEW match against Adam Cole, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.41.
Back on this day in 2026, Page & Strickland vs. Hobbs & Hook settled things in a Lights Out match, headlining the show on Dynamite, rated 6.49 in a hard-hitting tag team clash.

secondaries.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Proud-N-Powerful & Kingston vs. 2.O & Garcia fought it out in a No Holds Barred match, topping the bill that night on Rampage, rated 6.14 in a fast-paced six-man clash.
Back on this day in 2026, Jon Moxley vs. Shelton Benjamin locked horns for the first time, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 7.21 ? a good, competitive contest.
2026 brought us this moment: it was the first-ever encounter between Bandido and Sammy Guevara on Dynamite, rated 6.76.
